property_summary: For any recipient address that has not yet claimed the bonus, calling getFirstWithdrawalBonus(recipient) on the correct contract always results in claimedBonus[recipient] becoming true (the function completes successfully), while the mutant that adds 0 can still complete but will make the withdrawn amount (and thus post-call rewardsForA) different — specifically, there exist recipients for which the mutant causes the call to revert due to sending 0 value to a receiver that rejects zero-value calls (the reference sends 100 wei and succeeds).
change_summary: Change the increment to not add the bonus (set to add 0 instead of 100), so rewardsForA and thus funds withdrawn differ after the call.
